direction.owner_decision: Retain direction A, which the owner approved on 2026-09-21. This PR changes how the specification is requested (a generate call followed by a translate call) and makes no rendered UI change.

author: Copilot implementation session efaf31cf-a7ff-4ae9-adb8-7e933005b657
review_notes: Independent review of 089b034 found one medium issue: flat 4,000-token ceilings over-reserved gpt-6-luna TPM. 22d8499 resolves it, and the follow-up review found no new issues in the sized ceilings, heading de-duplication or per-part data. For this receipt the reviewer confirmed the screenshot hashes (byte-identical to the 7ff33b6 desktop.png and mobile.png), CI run 43015625154, the runner's per-width coverage, zero accessibility failures in browser-results.json, and the translation-failure path by code inspection. The reviewer's three corrections (JS delta attribution, code-inspection wording, missing limitations) were applied. Live timings, the 18-of-20 capture comparison and the initial-JS delta are author-measured.

primary_task.evidence: The exact-source CI preview (run 43015625154) passed the full mocked journey at 1440 px and 390 px. The English specification arrives from /api/generate-description; selecting Latvian (desktop) or Estonian (mobile) renders the heading returned by the separate /api/translate-description call, with no fallback notice and no page errors. CI lint, type check, 164 Vitest tests and the API build passed on the same commit.

keyboard.evidence: No component, markup or focus code changed. The runner's Enter/Space upload, Enter room review and Enter socket placement passed at 1440 px and 390 px, and paywall Escape passed at 390 px.

responsive.evidence: The runner found no horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 px. desktop.png (1440 px) and mobile.png (390 px) are byte-identical to the approved 7ff33b6 captures.

states.evidence: Analysis and calculation waiting/error and Markdown-renderer failure passed at both widths, and empty analysis/review passed at 390 px. By code inspection, a failed generate or translate call throws inside the existing calculation try block and reaches the same calculation-error state, which keeps placements and offers retry; a retry reruns calculate, generate and translate. The two failure captures differ from 7ff33b6 only in the drawing date printed in the room-layout SVG header.

accessibility.evidence: Measured text contrast, control border/focus contrast and 200% text enlargement passed in every phase recorded in browser-results.json. No markup, styles or semantics changed.

performance.evidence: Initial decoded JavaScript is 264,579 bytes, 596 bytes more than the approved 7ff33b6 capture; that difference includes dependency updates merged since 7ff33b6 as well as the second fetch in src/api.ts. Markdown and PDF chunks stay deferred. Live runs on gpt-6-luna measured 11.0-12.3 s to generate and 12.4-13.2 s to translate, against 39.8 s and 57.5 s for the single call.

visual_intent.evidence: The rendered product is unchanged: 18 of 20 captured screens are byte-identical to the approved 7ff33b6 evidence, and the other two differ only in the printed drawing date. The receipt screenshots show direction A rendered from 22d8499.

limitations: Browser journeys use synthetic API fixtures; no fixture exercises a failed generate or translate call.
Live gpt-6-luna timings were measured by the author with a local harness, not through the browser.
The 18-of-20 byte-identical comparison with 7ff33b6 was measured by the author; only desktop.png and mobile.png were retained and independently checked.
Chromium only; no physical-device test or WCAG certification.
The authenticated end-to-end run on the live site remains with the owner, because /api/* requires the authenticated role.
